:::{.definition data-title="Arbitrage Portfolio"}

A portfolio $h$ is said to be **arbitrage** is the **value process** of the
portfolio satisfies the following properties
$$
\begin{align}V_0^h&=0\\V_t^{h}&>0\quad\text{w.p.}\quad 1\end{align}
$$

:::

An arbitrage portfolio is therefore any investment opportunity that is
guaranteed to make money over the market rate of interest.
